name: The Philco Television Playhouse
description: The Philco Television Playhouse is an American anthology series that was broadcast live on NBC from 1948 to 1955. Produced by Fred Coe, the series was sponsored by Philco. It was one of the most respected dramatic shows of the Golden Age of Television, winning a 1954 Peabody Award and receiving eight Emmy nominations between 1951 and 1956.

videos.title: Dinner at Eight
videos.overview: Social-climbing Mrs. Oliver Jordan, whose husband's firm is in financial trouble, feels obligated to reciprocate hospitality for a visiting British aristocratic couple by arranging a small dinner party. The guests are chosen both to impress--a faded stage star, a well-known if over-the-hill alcoholic actor--and to meet certain social obligations. This means the necessary inclusion of a philandering doctor and his wife, and a gauche, nouveau-riche couple who are loathed but powerful.

videos.title: Rebecca
videos.overview: Brooding and moody Maxim deWinter returns from an extended trip to the continent with a young bride, less than a year after the tragic death of hi first wife, Rebecca. The staff of Manderley, his country home, including Mrs Danvers the housekeeper who rules over the house, are still devoted to their former mistress, the socialite Rebecca and they find it difficult to accept the new, shy Mrs deWinter who is inexperienced running a large home.

videos.title: Counsellor-at-Law
videos.overview: An upscale Manhattan attorney torn between his greedy practices of insider trading and embezzlement and his desire to help the working-class Jews from his old neighborhood.

videos.title: Angel in the Wings
videos.overview: An understudy for a stage show's star takes over when an accident circumvents the stars performance. The understudy takes over and brings down the house.

videos.title: Street Scene
videos.overview: Abraham Kaplan lives with his family in a row house populated by a kaleidoscope of characters looking to break out of poverty. Kaplan's revolutionary, socialist views grate against some of his neighbors.

videos.title: This Thing Called Love
videos.overview: A professional couple marry and the wife insists on celibacy for three months to see if they really are compatible or not. The husband tries to lure her with all kinds of excuses and tricks to the marital bed.

videos.title: Camille
videos.overview: Camille, a beautiful courtesan and Armand Duval, a young man in the foreign service, are in love. Their relationship  jeopardizes his career and prevents the marriage of his sister into a ""respectable"" family, if Duval marries Camille. Camille becomes ill and dies.

videos.title: An Inspector Calls
videos.overview: When Inspector Goole calls unexpectedly on the prosperous Birling family, his startling revelations not only shatter the very foundations of their lives, but challenge us all to examine our consciences.

videos.title: I Like It Here
videos.overview: Willie is a refugee who works as a houseman at a professor's home. He's a sweet and lovable man even when he's interfering in other people's lives. The Professor's daughter is in love with Brad, a young lawyer. Of course, Willie sees fit to give Brad all kinds of advice.

videos.title: Suspect
videos.overview: 20 years ago, a Scotswoman was accused of an ax murder and let off with the ignominious Scottish verdict of Not Proven. She changes her name and lives down her past, but when her son becomes engaged, his fiancée's godfather spots the mother and recognizes her. In his efforts to trap her, and hers not to be trapped trouble arises.

videos.title: Parlor Story
videos.overview: An ambitious professor wants to become President of his university. He is soon caught up in the political opportunism of the State Governor, the wiles of an unscrupulous newspaper publisher and the parlor tricks of his own meddling wife.

videos.title: A Christmas Carol
videos.overview: The skinflint Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: The Old Lady Shows Her Medals
videos.overview: The basement flat of Mrs Dowey, a Scottish charwoman who lives and works in London, during World War I, and Mrs Dowey and her guests - three other charwomen whom she has invited for tea - are discussing the tactics of trench warfare with the confidence of people who have never been near the Front.

videos.title: Ramshackle Inn
videos.overview: An old maid librarian has saved her money for twenty years, in order to buy a hotel where she can meet interesting people. She purchases a strange rundown place near the ocean and gets what she bargains for.

videos.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
videos.overview: The poetry-spouting soldier with the oversized nose, Cyrano uses the handsome but inarticulate Christian as a conduit for his feelings, the ugly but eloquent Cyrano pours his heart out to the lovely Roxanne. And she, wooed by the beauty of the words, falls in love with Christian, not realizing that it is Cyrano whose voice has aroused her passion.

videos.title: Papa Is All
videos.overview: Papa is an ugly tempered, overly strict, scrupulously religious Pennsylvanian Dutch, his wife and children rebel.

videos.title: Pride and Prejudice
videos.overview: The trials of a woman trying to find husbands for her five daughters in 18th-century England.

videos.title: Dark Hammock
videos.overview: In a remote part of Florida Coral Platt, a sinister woman has married a man considerably older than she. For reasons sufficient to her, she wants him out of the way and plans an ingenious though slow murder by poison. She has succeeded in making it seem that Marvin is dying through natural causes. However, she is forced unexpectedly to play hostess to two women who have come to Florida. The women stay longer than they planned because they have begun to suspect what Coral is up to. In a series of exciting scenes they discover just what is going on and prevent Marvin's death.

videos.title: The Late Christopher Bean
videos.overview: Dr. Haggett and his family, who have some of Bean's canvases, suddenly realize their value, and become hard, selfish, and ill-tempered. It is Abby, the family servant, who ultimately holds them all in her power; she has one of the greatest paintings, which she cannot be persuaded into selling or giving away. She is the only one who really understood the artist -- besides, she had been married to him!

videos.title: The Story of Mary Surratt
videos.overview: After the death of her husband Mary opened a boardinghouse to pay the debts owed by her husband. .. There she began a respectable boardinghouse business and met the man who would ultimately lead to her inglorious place in history - John Wilkes Booth.

videos.title: Twelfth Night
videos.overview: Viola, a young woman who disguises herself as a man to work as a page in the court of Count Orsino. Orsino is hopelessly in love with a woman named Olivia, and soon Viola finds herself hopelessly in love with Orsino. But Orsino thinks she's a man, and her predicament worsens when she realizes that Olivia has fallen in love with her.

videos.title: St. Helena
videos.overview: On St. Helena, the exiled emperor Napoleon Bonaparte is grim when his faithful Corscian attendant Cipriani dies. In his confinement he's suffering from a bad liver and a sulking mistress all this begins to weigh heavy on him as he continues to be haunted by spectres of his mistakes. He cannot forget, he says, that if he had not attacked so soon at Waterloo, he would have had 12,000 more men. The imperial manners gradually give way to those of a lonely and embittered country squire. Feeling death upon him at last, he hears that a comet has appeared in the sky.

videos.title: The Druid Circle
videos.overview: An embittered professor comes near to wrecking the lives of a young man and young woman whose love for each other has been accidentally revealed to him through a letter written by the boy to the girl. The professor uses this to humiliate the young people, unconsciously venting upon them his own perverse cruelty for the disappointment suffered in his own life.

videos.title: Quality Street
videos.overview: Because she's nearly 30 and still unwed, Phoebe Throssel is regarded as an over-the-hill spinster. Thus, when offered the opportunity for a reunion with Captain Brown, whom she hasn't seen in years, Phoebe desperately wants to rekindle his affections.

videos.title: Dinner at Antoine's
videos.overview: The murder of a woman at a dinner party unveils a multitude of twists and turns as the murderer is uncovered.

videos.title: Becky Sharp
videos.overview: A scheming illegitimate girl trying to claw her way up in English society. However, fate never seems to give her an even break.

videos.title: And Never Been Kissed
videos.overview: A sixteen-year-old girl tries everything to attract the opposite sex.

videos.title: What Makes Sammy Run?
videos.overview: The story of Sammy Glick, the man with a positive genius for being a heel, who runs through New York's East Side, through newspaper ranks and finally through Hollywood, leaving in his wake the wrecked careers of his associates; for this is his tragedy and his chief characteristic-his congenital incapacity for friendship.

videos.title: Mr. Mergenthwirker's Lobblies
videos.overview: Only Mr. Mergenthwirker, a person pure of heart, can see the lobblies, which are invisible fairy-like creatures.

videos.title: Burlesque
videos.overview: Vaudevillians Skid and Bonnie are partners onstage and off -- until success comes to Skip. He develops an oversized ego and a taste for booze, which alienates Bonnie. But his friends struggle to help him redeem himself.

videos.title: Macbeth
videos.overview: Scottish nobleman who prompted by his own prophecy and ambitions, kills a king to wear his crown.

videos.title: Romeo and Juliet
videos.overview: Star crossed lovers, Romeo and Juliet are doomed from the start by the hatred of their families.

videos.title: This Time, Next Year
videos.overview: The ghost of Ulysses S. Grant materialises every year at Grant's Tomb.

videos.title: It Pays to Advertise
videos.overview: With the aide of his secretary and an ad man, he creates an enormously popular product and cant keep up with the demand.

videos.title: Summer Formal
videos.overview: A charming young girl comes to live in a household of an elderly priest.  Jenny, 18, is the precise opposite of the kind of smart sophisticated young miss that puzzles and exasperates Father Moynihan.  The plot is concerned with the priest's clumsy endeavors to make Jenny attractive to the boys.

videos.title: Jenny Kissed Me
videos.overview: A charming young girl comes to live in a household of an elderly priest. The 18-year-old Jenny is the precise opposite of the kind of smart sophisticated young miss that puzzles and exasperates Father Moynihan. The priest makes clumsy endeavours to make Jenny attractive to the boys.

videos.title: Dark of the Moon
videos.overview: A witch boy named John who falls in love with a beautiful girl named Barbara Allen. John has a conjure woman turn him into a human. The only condition of the spell is that Barbara must remain faithful to John for one full year after they are married. If Barbara is not faithful, then John will turn back into a witch boy.

videos.title: For Love or Money
videos.overview: A young woman shows up during a thunderstorm at the country home of a famous actor.

videos.title: The Five Lives of Richard Gordon
videos.overview: Katie Gordon, Richard's long suffering wife, has put up with his shenanigans to the point where she seeks a divorce. Her restless and bored spouse just keeps finding himself in hot water.

videos.title: You Touched Me!
videos.overview: The adopted son of a drunken former sea captain returns to the household as an adult. He asks the old man for his eldest daughter's hand in marriage. Everyone believes it's an attempt to secure an inheritance.

videos.title: The Fourth Wall
videos.overview: The life of a middle-aged couple has become to complacent and empty.

videos.title: Enter Madame
videos.overview: A grand opera prima donna who practically deserts her husband to follow her career, even though she loves her better half. While the pampered pet of a suite of servants and receiving the homage of operatic mad foreigners, she believes he is sitting at home in Boston immersed in his work. Instead he has fallen for a designing widow and has about decided to divorce his songbird wife.

videos.title: A Murder Has Been Arranged
videos.overview: A ghost story set in a theatre, legend claims a dumb woman will appear on stage and reveal the identity of a murderer.

videos.title: Pretty Little Parlor
videos.overview: A little soirée is interrupted by a murder and the guests are all suspect in the pretty little parlor.

videos.title: Three Cornered Moon
videos.overview: Nellie Rimpleger tries to hold together her eccentric family (including her children, saucy daughter Elizabeth, law student Kenneth, and Eddie, a would-be actor) after they lose their fortune in the stock-market crash. While Elizabeth works in a shoe factory and tries to help her brothers find jobs, she falls in love with a melancholy writer, but marries a wealthy doctor.

videos.title: What Every Woman Knows
videos.overview: A Victorian Scotswoman of far-reaching ambition. Using her supposedly frail feminine wiles, she maneuvers her fatuous husband into a successful political career. He rises to a parliamentary seat, never quite realizing that he hasn't done it alone.

videos.title: Pride's Castle
videos.overview: Pride Dawson was one of those "Robber Barons", who started out his life in rags and turned his life to riches and women. His contempt for human decency or moral restraint left him ruthless and corrupt. He falls for Sharon O'Neill who is a woman filled with so much goodness in her soul, as much as he has evil in his.

videos.title: The Little Sister
videos.overview: A woman from Kansas comes to Marlowe to help find her missing brother.

videos.title: The Lonely
videos.overview: An engaged Air Force lieutenant goes on a ten-day furlough to Scotland with a female friend. Their understanding is that the trip will be purely platonic; instead, they fall madly in love. At his first opportunity, the lieutenant flies back to America to break the news to his fiancé and family.

videos.title: The Queen Bee
videos.overview: A conniving and devious  Southern socialite who manipulates the lives of those around her with tragic results.

videos.title: Something's Got to Give
videos.overview: A couple of New England housewives disrupt their marriages by becoming an early morning radio team.

videos.title: The Last Tycoon
videos.overview: A 1930's brilliant and efficient movie mogul and the story behind the Hollywood Dream Factory.

videos.title: Because of the Lockwoods
videos.overview: The Lockwoods are patronising toward their former neighbours, the Hunters, who are now living in the poorer district in town. The Hunters are saved from despair from the help of a young junk dealer named Oliver Read, who teaches the Lockwoods a lesson in humanity.

videos.title: Damion's Daughter
videos.overview: A theater owner's daughter discovers his father's true nature and is shaken by the discovery. She moments jealousy backstage to expose him.

videos.title: The House of Seven Gables
videos.overview: With the ownership of Seven Gables, the opulent family estate, at stake, a man frames his brother for murder.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: A husband and wife are drifting apart due to different goals in their individual careers.

videos.title: The Wonderful Mrs. Ingram
videos.overview: A female psychiatrist visits the home of a famous woman novelist and discovers unhappiness aplenty. She learns the novelist's ambitions and vanity are causes of the trouble.

videos.title: Mist on the Waters
videos.overview: Blackmail terrorizes a couple because of an accident which was a terrible tragedy.

videos.title: The Beautiful Bequest
videos.overview: The story of a spoiled and jilted young novelist of intellectual pretensions, who is freshened up and made marketable and happy again by design of his sporting publisher.

videos.title: The Strange Christmas Dinner
videos.overview: A modern day Ebenezer Scrooge refuses to close his store on Christmas Day.

videos.title: In Beauty Like the Night
videos.overview: A British pilot who lost his sight during the Second World War deals with the problems caused by the injury.

videos.title: Little Boy Lost
videos.overview: An English poet searches for his son whom he has never seen. The child disappeared shortly after his mother was killed by the Gestapo.

videos.title: Bethel Merriday
videos.overview: A small-town girl named Bethel Merriday is determined to become an actress.

videos.title: Murder at the Stork Club
videos.overview: A wealthy matron is murdered at the Stork Club and the suspect list is growing.

videos.title: The Marriages
videos.overview: In England in the 1890s, Colonel Chart, a widower with four children, falls in love with a charming, wealthy American widow, Mrs. Churchley, but his 27-year-old spinster daughter Adela contrives to ruin the relationship. She also turns two of the other three children against their intended stepmother and spoils the widow's plans to help Adela's brother Godfrey out of an unpleasant situation.

videos.title: Uncle Dynamite
videos.overview: Uncle Fred wants Pongo to marry Sally Painter, an unsuccessful American sculptor. They had been engaged but she broke it off when Pongo refused to smuggle jewellery into America for a friend of hers.

videos.title: The Sudden Guest
videos.overview: A New England spinster Miss Leckton disregards her neighbours' cry for help and assistance during a hurricane. She resents the intrusion, especially since her neighbours happen to be Jews.

videos.title: Ann Rutledge
videos.overview:
The short life of Ann Rutledge,  Abraham Lincoln's one true love who passed

away at age 22 of typhoid fever.

videos.title: A Letter to Mr. Priest
videos.overview: An attorney, voted most likely to succeed in college, looks back on his life.

videos.title: Hometown
videos.overview: Mitchell Hickok, an author from the country, comes to New York for a publicity build-up for his book. He meets a glamorous woman, who introduces him to the nightlife of Manhattan. He soon tires of cafés, cocktail parties, and public appearances, and returns to his simple way of living in the country and Eileen, his childhood sweetheart.

videos.title: The Life of Vincent Van Gogh
videos.overview: The tragic life story of the tormented artist.

videos.title: The Uncertain Molly Collicutt
videos.overview: A flirtatious woman has a difficult time settling down to her marital responsibilities.

videos.title: The Trial of Steven Kent
videos.overview: A jury foreman seeks to wreak personal vengeance on the murder defendant.

videos.title: The Second Oldest Profession
videos.overview: An idealistic newspaper editor battles with his stubborn publisher.

videos.title: Nocturne
videos.overview: In London in 1910, two sisters, Jenny and Emmy Blanchard, must support and care for their widowed, invalid father. Jenny, the younger, pretty sister, seeks to escape from the depressing reality of her poverty-stricken home, while Emmy, the older, plain sister, finds comfort and eventual happiness by serving their ailing father. At the end, both are engaged: Jenny will marry Keith Reddington and Emmy will wed Alf Rylett.

videos.title: Dirty Eddie
videos.overview: Dirty Eddie is a sleek black pig with a fat movie contract and Hollywood isn't too happy about it.

videos.title: The End is Known
videos.overview: A department store tycoon comes home and is nearly hit by a falling body. He then learns the suicide jumped from his apartment. A mystery surrounds a suicide.

videos.title: The Man in the Black Hat
videos.overview: A gambler has nothing to lose as his shady past with women and cards catch up to him.

videos.title: The American
videos.overview: An American travelling in Europe finds clashes between the two cultures.

videos.title: The Feast
videos.overview: A seaside resort hotel brings together an odd assortment of people: a frustrated married couple, four young lovers, children and an grouchy old miser.

videos.title: Brat Farrar
videos.overview: Identical twins concoct a plan to defraud an insurance company and collect a large sum of cash.

videos.title: The Charmed Circle
videos.overview: A poverty-ridden student feels out-of-place among his wealthy fraternity brothers. He eventually falls in love with a rich girl and leads a revolt against the President of the fraternity house.

videos.title: Semmelweis
videos.overview: Story of the great physician who saved millions of lives due to his discovery of the cause of childbed fever (puerperal fever) and eliminated its danger by prescribing the absolute sterlization of all instruments and the cleanliness of all persons coming in contact with the mother.

videos.title: Sense and Sensibility
videos.overview: Sisters left poor by the death of the family matriarch search for suitable husbands in Georgian England.

videos.title: The Bump on Brannigan's Head
videos.overview: A bonk on the head turns a grouchy hothead into the sweetest man in town. Brannigan runs for mayor of his small town--and wins--with his "love everybody" campaign. He even wins over the crooked newspaper publisher.

videos.title: Anything Can Happen
videos.overview: A Russian emigrant to America finds a new language, and strange manners bewildering but tries mightily to adapt to his new homeland.

videos.title: Hear My Heart Speak
videos.overview: A shell-shocked WWI ex-soldier is unable to speak though doctors say the problem isn't physical. Tired of completing with his overbearing, doting mother, the woman he loves begins to withdraw from his life. It's then that he regains his ability to talk.

videos.title: The Reluctant Landlord
videos.overview: Georgi, a kindly and honest immigrant from the Georgian area of Russia, experiences many difficulties as he tries to adapt to his adopted country. He works hard to make a place for himself in America, all the while fighting with the English language and the strange customs of an alien people.

videos.title: The Tentacles
videos.overview: A young wife fights to free her husband from the control of his manipulative and controlling father.

videos.title: High Tor
videos.overview: Van Dorn is getting the hard sell from businessmen wanting to buy his mountain, High Tor, for commercial use. When the group becomes trapped by a landslide, Van Dorn goes for help and encounters a Dutchwoman who's been haunting the mountain for two centuries.

videos.title: Dear Guest and Ghost
videos.overview: A mother receives help with her troublesome kids from a friendly ghost.

videos.title: The Touch of a Stranger
videos.overview: A scientist's life has been destroyed by another man's greed and takes out his anger on three innocent strangers, implicating them in his own death.

videos.title: The Vine That Grew on Fiftieth Street
videos.overview: Seeds planted in a New York City backyard grow into a magical plant that brings happiness to those living near it. Formerly unpleasant neighbors turn into caring, warm-hearted individuals.

videos.title: A Husband for Mama
videos.overview: The three children of a widowed woman scheme to get their mother a new husband, setting their sites on a middle-aged doctor.

videos.title: Portrait in Smoke
videos.overview: A debt collector searches for the woman who saved him from an armed holdup; he wants her to have a $1000 reward. As he talks with those who knew her, he learns that she was a siren with a couple of murders to her credit.

videos.title: The Gambler
videos.overview: A scathing denunciation of gambling and feudal aristocrats of the 19th Century, this story relates how Philip, a young medical student, bargains away his career for the unsure success of high gambling stakes. His caution turns to uncontrollable greed when he learns that money can buy women and quick fame. His destiny is bound to Theresa's, a beautiful young woman who has been mortgaged in marriage for her stepfather's debt, and to her wealthy grandmother's, who chooses to gamble away her fortune so there will be no inheritors.

videos.title: The Power Devil
videos.overview: A young attorney involves himself in many shady deals as he pursues political ambitions. His wife speaks up and demands he clean up his act. The threat of disbarment also contributes to his final decision.

videos.title: The Man Who Got Away With It
I'm Still Alive
videos.overview: A mousy teacher at a small school had written a swashbuckling story filled with international spies and adventure. Unbeknownst to him, the story is sold to a newspaper as a true account of his life. Suddenly, femme fatales and real gangsters are paying him visits.

videos.title: Torch for a Dark Journey
videos.overview: A Czech scientist escapes from Prague with the aid of an American industrialist, who wants to hire him for his personal benefit. The scientist is followed by a former student, now a fanatic Communist, who insists that the scientist must return to his own country to work for the People's Republic. The scientist must decide whether to return or abandon his countrymen and accept personal freedom in America.

videos.title: Bonanza
videos.overview: The residents of a Western ghost town won't admit that their gold rush "boom town" days ended long ago.

videos.title: The Pupil
videos.overview: A tutor hired to instruct an uncontrollable 10-year-old soon recognizes the child's problem: it's his parents. The boy has had never received any affection from his negligent mother and father.

videos.title: The Symbol: Jefferson Davis
videos.overview: Three decades in the life of the Confederate president are covered by three women: each of his two wives, and his daughter.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: The final confession of the highest degree. A compelling story, told by the eyes of the beholder.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: The story of the biggest POW-camp escape of World War II.

videos.title: A Matter of Life and Death
Kitty Doone
videos.overview: A faded movie star schemes to keep her career at all costs.

videos.title: Let Them Be Sea Captains
videos.overview: Horace Greeley, volatile editor of The New York tribune, and Margaret Fuller, the mid-19th century feminist and first woman employed on the newspaper's staff.

videos.title: The Man Who Bought a Town
videos.overview: A butcher purchases the town he calls home to preserve its quiet lifestyle.

videos.title: No Medals on Pop
videos.overview: A young boy believes his father deserves a medal for being in the war and is heartbroken when he finds out the truth and how his father disgraced the family.

videos.title: The Dark Corridor
videos.overview: The story of the Marr family which is made up of a dominant mother who bates everyone, the vacillating son, his wife, and the blind son. Then a new maid arrives, a maid who has served a term in prison as an accessory to a murder.

videos.title: Bulletin 120
videos.overview: In Mississippi in 1915, Dr. Joseph Goldberger works with a test group of convicts and discovers that pellagra is caused by a dietary deficiency and not infection.

videos.title: Parnassus on Wheels
videos.overview: In 1900's New England, Helen McGuill buys a horse-drawn, traveling bookstore, "Parnassus," from its owner, Roger McGuill. Roger travels with Helen in the beginning of her book-selling odyssey, and out of that comes adventure and romance.

videos.title: Routine Assignment
videos.overview: A reporter gets a confession of robbery from a man only to have the man then deny his guilt in a complex twist of events.

videos.title: The Birth of the Movies
videos.overview: Drama on the career of D.W. Griffith. Producer Fred Coe briefly talks with Lillian Gish before and following the drama.

videos.title: Mr. Arcularis
videos.overview: After undergoing important surgery, Mr. Arcularis goes on a long ocean voyage - where increasingly strange things occur.

videos.title: A Secret Island
videos.overview: A vicious woman is determined to see her niece wed for money and social position instead of for love.

videos.title: The Visitors
videos.overview: A young boy's disappearance when his mother remarries leads to a mystery when he is found and has forgotten who he is.

videos.title: Justice and Mr. Pleznik
videos.overview: The story of a naturalized immigrant's first experience with jury duty.

videos.title: The Adventures of Hiram Holliday
videos.overview: A mild-mannered proof-reader goes on a world tour, and demonstrates several esoteric skills whilst undergoing exciting adventures.

videos.title: The Fast Dollar
videos.overview: A humorous tale of life in a small town and its impact on a would-be confidence man.

videos.title: Operation: Airlift
videos.overview: The story of the Berlin airlift, when the Western Allies organized the Berlin Airlift to carry supplies to the people in West Berlin. The success of the airlift humiliated the Soviets claiming that such a thing would never work.

videos.title: Dr. Hudson's Secret Journal
videos.overview: Widower Dr. Hudson lives with his daughter and housekeeper and keeps his medical practice success by using the Good book as guidance.

videos.title: The Plot
videos.overview: Widower Dr. Hudson lives with his daughter and housekeeper and keeps his medical practice success by using the Good book as guidance.

videos.title: Case History
videos.overview: A sleuthing psychiatrist probes a murder in his fiancee's home and stirs up a hornet's nest with his future in-laws.

videos.title: I Want to March
videos.overview: The year is 1915 and the suffragettes cause a stir in the home of a zoology professor as his wife takes up the banner of "women's rights".

videos.title: Pretend I Am A Stranger
videos.overview: The story of a British soldier and his buddy's widow as the two grow closer in their grief.

videos.title: Television Story
videos.overview: A covetous young actress' career means more to her than marriage to a middle-aged actor who turns to TV after a successful career in other facets of show business only to find that his wife influences his work there.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: An amnesia victim is told by his alleged stepfather that he is heir to a fortune. When his so-called family greet him with reserve, however he gets busy to iron out the unreal problem.

videos.title: Ephraim Tutt's Clean Hands
videos.overview: Lawyer Tutt refuses to cross the street for a $5 million account, but goes clear to Pottsville to draw up a will for Jim Lawton, staying there until he successfully contests a claim to a woman's farm.

videos.title: Come Alive
videos.overview: An arrogant woman whose self-centered tactics cause endless grief for her secretary, husband, sister and anyone who comes into contact with her.

videos.title: Night at the Vulcan
videos.overview: When an actor is murdered backstage, the cast of the production become the suspects, seems the actor had plenty of enemies.

videos.title: This Time Next Year
videos.overview: The ghost of Ulysses S. Grant materializes every year at the same time, at his tomb, Grant's Tomb.

videos.title: Women of Intrigue
videos.overview: In this tale of Communist intrigue set in England, a man who works for the foreign office disappears.

videos.title: The Wayward Season
videos.overview: A composer's reaction to his daughter's marriage to a middle-aged man brings changes in his own life.

videos.title: The Spur
videos.overview: After the assassination of President Lincoln, John Wilkes Booth leaped to the stage below, his spur became entangled in the American flag draping the balcony causing Booth to break his leg.

videos.title: By-Line for Murder
videos.overview: A bitter assistant foreign editor of a London newspaper commits murder in the newspaper office after being passed over yet again for a promotion.

videos.title: Requiem for a Model A
videos.overview: After buying a very used car, a writer uncovers some very unusual items under one of the seat cushions. The story of the vehicle's former owners is told via flashbacks.

videos.title: Marcia Akers
videos.overview: A young woman has an unhealthy desire to get ahead, climbing the social ladder and stepping on people along the way. She's set to marry a wealthy man--just what's always wanted--when she finds herself in love with a "regular guy".

videos.title: The Education of a Fullback
